title: 第1381章  灭叶家，娶凤轻语
content_zh:
“嗯？”
叶天龙眼神一眯。
你别说，这声音的确有些熟悉。
但他一时想不起，这前辈是谁。
而且，他何德何能，能同这样强大的前辈有交集啊。
“看来你真没听出来。罢了，就让你见一下我的真实面目吧。”
叶天龙闻言，拱手道：“晚辈荣幸之至！”
“荣幸吗？呵呵。”
楚弛笑了，他很期待待会叶天龙看见他的样子后，到底是怎样的眼神！
冷笑后，楚弛身上的灵光消失不见。
所有人都看清楚了他的面孔。
看见他面孔的那一刻，叶家人全部惊呆了。
这绝世强者，怎么这么年轻？
是服用了什么能永葆青春的天材地宝吗？
当然，现场最震惊的人，非叶天龙莫属！
他头发都炸开了！整个人差点从地上跳起来。
“是……是你！”
很显然，他认出了楚弛。
楚弛这张脸，他这辈子都不可能忘记。
但随后他摇头道：“不可能，不可能。你不是……”

叶天龙的话还没有说完，楚弛戏谑地道：“你是不是想说，我不是被你杀了全家，灰飞烟灭，尸骨无存了吗？”
楚弛的话落，现场叶家人倒吸一口凉气。
什么意思？
难道叶天龙，杀了这位前辈的全家？
但这怎么可能啊，这前辈绝对是传说中的帝境强者。
叶天龙哪里来的实力，杀他全家啊？
而且叶天龙怎么可能这么傻！敢去得罪强者。
“真的是你，怎么可能，怎么可能！”
叶天龙惊讶得眼珠子都要瞪出来了。
楚弛戏谑地道：“叶天龙，你现在的表情，我很喜欢。你还记得，你第一次见我的时候，你有多高傲吗？但现在这是怎么了？你的高傲怎么不见、只剩下惊恐了？算了，同你说这么多，只是浪费口水，毕竟，你都快死了！”
“叶天龙，当日你灭了我整个镇子，现在我灭你整个叶家，很公平吧？”
叶天龙还没有说话，现场的老者纷纷冷喝。
“你要灭我叶家！！”
“哼，你真以为我叶家，那么好欺负吗？金龙杀阵，开！””
叶家人终究不是普通人。
他们忽然开启了叶家的大杀阵。
阵法开启的那一刻，地动山摇！
没多久，一条巨大的金龙，慢慢升到了空中。
这金龙杀阵，倒是有点威压。
但，这根本不是帝级阵法。

就算是，楚弛也无惧。
体内，所有霸穴的力量全部运集到右拳。
楚弛一拳击向了，朝他撕咬而来的巨大金龙。
他的身体，比起阵法金龙来，就显得渺小多了。
但就是这渺小的身体，一拳碎了巨大的阵法金龙！
“什么！这怎么可能！”
“他到底是谁？怎么会如此恐怖啊！”
叶家人这时候似乎才开始怕了。
“就这？护族大阵？叶天龙，受死！”
天上，楚弛懒得多说，他隔空伸出手。
叶天龙的身体不受控制，朝楚弛飞了过去。
叶家人想要阻止，却根本阻止不了。
叶天龙的身体，悬浮在空中，呈现一个大字。
下一刻，大字开始分解！
叶天龙的手脚，被一股神奇的力量，瞬间扯断！
甚至，连脑袋，也一同被扯断了。
这简直是五马分尸之刑。
脑袋被扯断后，叶天龙还没有死。
但这种状态，比马上死了还难受！
甚至，叶天龙到现在都一直在重复，不可能，不可能！

因为楚弛在他眼里，只是一只蝼蚁，而这蝼蚁，早就死得不能再死了。
他怎么会忽然出现，还忽然变得这么强的！
“叶天龙，还没死透吧？那就正好看着我一巴掌灭你叶家！”
楚弛的声音再次传来。
声音落，一道巨大的巴掌，忽然从天而降。
现场的无敌皇强者，也根本反应不够来。
随着轰隆一声巨响，地动山摇。
叶家在那一瞬间，化为了废墟！
四大古世家之一的叶家。
就此灭亡。
“不！”
叶天龙想要嘶吼，却根本发不出任何声音来。
他的脑袋，更是一阵眩晕。
那是因为灵魂，已经在消散了。
没多久，他就彻底失去了意识。
“死了吗？”
楚弛摇了摇头，彻底捏爆了叶天龙的脑袋。
随后他大手一挥，尘埃中飞起了密密麻麻的储物戒指。
这些储物戒指，全部被楚弛收入了储物戒指。
叶家的资源，成为了他的资源！

他在要在些资源里面，整理出一些好东西，然后上凤家提亲！
他带楚家人来这里，就是为了提亲！
他原本打算，是让楚家人都成长起来，再去凤家。
但现在才发现，他根本等不及。
既然叶家都灭了，那现在就去提亲吧！
反正他已经成帝，这皇朝没有人能奈何他。
当天下午，楚弛就带着楚家人，前往凤家提亲了。
凤家人本不知道楚弛是谁，直到楚弛说，是他灭了叶家！
另外，他当着叶家的人，变身成为了兽修！
神兽的威压，释放而出。
那一刻，凤家人发自内心地同意这门婚事。
因为楚弛告诉他们，他觉醒的是神龙血！
所以，他们同意了这门婚事。
当晚，凤家摆了三天三夜的酒席。
第四天，楚弛带着凤轻语，飞回了楚国！
既然是要成亲，自然要在楚国举办！
三天后，楚国举办了盛大的婚礼。
楚弛不仅娶了凤轻语，还娶了花弄影师心诺，还有元兰心。
这一晚，大被同眠！
这一晚，楚弛很开心。

他这一开心，就开心了整整半年！
没办法，他就是这么给力，就是这么持久。
半年后，床头上。
凤轻语的声音传来了。
“楚弛，你真是太讨厌了！这都半年了，你也太久了吧。对了，接下来你有什么打算？”
楚弛耸了耸肩道：“我能有什么打算？当然是好好和你们过好后半生。”
凤轻语摇头道：“我的意思是，你不想着去帝朝吗？去那里，你才能更进一步！甚至，你可以追求飞升成仙。”
楚弛却是摇头道：“成仙干什么？我要是成仙了，那你们怎么办？”
“也对哦，你可以想办法提升我们的修为，却不一定有办法，让我们都成仙。那以后我们就生活在楚国吗？”
“嗯，就生活在楚国吧。我觉得这里挺好。这里虽然灵气稀薄，但也正是灵气稀薄，才没什么强者来，我们在这里，绝对是天下无敌，无忧无虑。这里就是第二个无双大陆。”
“好，那我就在这里，陪你度过余生。另外，那我要给你十个儿子！”
楚弛嘿嘿一笑：“十个哪里够，我要一百个！对了，还能再来吗？你们三个，再来啊！”
（全书完）
content_en:
"Huh?"
Ye Tianlong narrowed his eyes.
Don't tell me, this voice is indeed familiar.
But he couldn't remember who this senior was.
Moreover, how could he be able to interact with such a powerful senior?
"It seems you really didn't hear me. Well, let me show you my true face."
When Ye Tianlong heard this, he cupped his hands and said: "This junior is extremely honored!"
"Is it an honor? Haha."
Chu Chi smiled. He was looking forward to what Ye Tianlong's eyes would look like when he saw him later!
After sneering, Chu Chi's aura disappeared.
Everyone could see his face clearly.
The moment they saw his face, everyone in the Ye family was shocked.
Why is this peerless strong man so young?
Did you take some natural treasure that can keep you young forever?
Of course, the most shocked person at the scene was none other than Ye Tianlong!
His hair exploded! The whole person almost jumped from the ground.
"It's...it's you!"
Obviously, he recognized Chu Chi.
Chu Chi's face would never be forgotten in his life.
But then he shook his head and said: "Impossible, impossible. You are not..."
Before Ye Tianlong finished speaking, Chu Chi said jokingly: "Are you trying to say, didn't you kill my whole family and wipe it out with no bones left?"
After Chu Chi finished speaking, the Ye family on the scene took a breath of cold air.
What's the meaning?
Could it be that Ye Tianlong killed this senior’s whole family?
But how is this possible? This senior is definitely a legendary Emperor Realm expert.
Where did Ye Tianlong get the strength to kill his whole family?
And how could Ye Tianlong be so stupid! Dare to offend the strong.
"It's really you, how is it possible, how is it possible!"
Ye Tianlong was so surprised that his eyes almost popped out.
Chu Chi said jokingly: "Ye Tianlong, I like your current expression very much. Do you still remember how arrogant you were when you first met me? But what happened now? Why is your arrogance gone and only fear is left? Forget it, talking to you so much is just a waste of words. After all, you are almost dead!"
"Ye Tianlong, you destroyed my entire town that day, now I'm going to destroy your entire Ye family, isn't it fair?"
Before Ye Tianlong could speak, the old men present shouted coldly.
"You want to destroy my Ye family!!"
"Hmph, do you really think my Ye family is so easy to bully? Golden Dragon Killing Formation, fire!"
After all, the Ye family are not ordinary people.
They suddenly activated the Ye family's killing array.
The moment the formation was activated, the earth shook!
Not long after, a huge golden dragon slowly rose into the sky.
This golden dragon killing formation is a bit coercive.
However, this is not an emperor-level formation at all.
Even if it is, Chu Chi is not afraid.
In the body, the power of all the domineering points is concentrated into the right fist.
Chu Chi punched the huge golden dragon that was biting towards him.
His body is much smaller than the Formation Golden Dragon.
But it was this tiny body that shattered the huge formation golden dragon with one punch!
"What! How is this possible! "
"Who is he? How could it be so terrifying! "
The Ye family seemed to be afraid at this time.
"That's it? Clan-protecting formation? Ye Tianlong, suffer death! "
In the sky, Chu Chi was too lazy to say anything more, so he stretched out his hand in the air.
Ye Tianlong's body was out of control and flew towards Chu Chi.
The Ye family wanted to stop it, but they couldn't.
Ye Tianlong's body was suspended in the air, with a big character appearing.
The next moment, the big characters began to decompose!
Ye Tianlong's hands and feet were torn off instantly by a magical force!
Even the head was torn off together.
This is simply the punishment of being quartered by five horses.
After his head was torn off, Ye Tianlong was not dead yet.
But this state is even more uncomfortable than dying right away!
In fact, Ye Tianlong has been repeating until now, impossible, impossible!
Because Chu Chi is just an ant in his eyes, and this ant has long since died..
How could he suddenly appear and become so powerful!
"Ye Tianlong, are you not dead yet? Then just watch me wipe out your Ye family with one slap!"
Chu Chi's voice came again.
As the voice fell, a huge slap suddenly fell from the sky.
The powerful Invincible Emperor on the scene could not react enough.
With a loud roar, the ground shook.
At that moment, the Ye family was reduced to ruins!
The Ye family, one of the four ancient aristocratic families.
Just perish.
"No!"
Ye Tianlong wanted to roar, but he couldn't make any sound at all.
His head felt dizzy.
That's because the soul is already dissipating.
Not long after, he completely lost consciousness.
"Dead?"
Chu Chi shook his head and completely crushed Ye Tianlong's head.
Then he waved his hand, and dense storage rings flew up from the dust.
These storage rings were all put into storage rings by Chu Chi.
The resources of the Ye family became his resources!
He is going to sort out some good things from some resources, and then go to the Feng family to propose marriage!
He brought the Chu family here just to propose marriage!
His original plan was to let the Chu family grow up before going to the Feng family.
But now he realized that he simply couldn't wait.
Since the Ye family has been destroyed, let’s propose marriage now!
Anyway, he has become the emperor, and no one in this dynasty can do anything to him.
That afternoon, Chu Chi took the Chu family to the Feng family to propose marriage.
The Feng family didn't know who Chu Chi was until Chu Chi said that he was the one who destroyed the Ye family!
In addition, he transformed into a beast cultivator in front of the Ye family!
The pressure of the divine beast was released.
At that moment, the Feng family agreed to the marriage from the bottom of their hearts.
Because Chu Chi told them that what he awakened was the blood of the dragon!
So, they agreed to the marriage.
That night, the Feng family held a banquet for three days and three nights.
On the fourth day, Chu Chi took Feng Qingyu and flew back to Chu Kingdom!
Since the wedding was going to happen, it naturally had to be held in Chu State!
Three days later, a grand wedding was held in Chu State.
Chu Chi not only married Feng Qingyu, but also married Hua Nong Photographer Xin Nuo, and Yuan Lan Xin.
This night, I was sleeping together!
This night, Chu Chi was very happy.
He was happy for half a year!
There's no way around it, he's just so powerful and so durable.
Half a year later, on the bedside.
Feng Qingyu's voice came.
"Chu Chi, you are so annoying! It's been half a year, and it's been too long for you. By the way, what are your plans next?"
Chu Chi shrugged and said, "What plans can I have? Of course I want to live the rest of my life with you."
Feng Qingyu shook her head and said: "What I mean is, don't you want to go to the Imperial Dynasty? Only by going there can you go one step further! You can even pursue ascending to immortality."
Chu Chi shook his head and said: "What do you do to become an immortal? If I become an immortal, what will you do?"
"That's right. You can find a way to improve our cultivation, but you may not be able to make us all immortals. Then will we live in the Chu Kingdom from now on?"
"Well, let's live in the Chu Kingdom. I think it's good here. Although the spiritual energy here is thin, it's because of the thin spiritual energy that no strong people come. Here, we are absolutely invincible and carefree. This is the second unrivaled continent."
"Okay, then I will stay here to spend the rest of my life with you. In addition, then I will give you ten sons!"
Chu Chi chuckled: "Ten is not enough, I want a hundred! By the way, can we come again? You three, come again!"
(Complete book)
